description: Source file implementing native simulator interface functions for a POSIX-based Nordic Semiconductor board, including hooks for CPU initialization, cleanup, and IRQ handling.

methods.name: nsif_cpun_pre_cmdline_hooks
methods.description: Hook to run native tasks before command line processing, sets auto-start if configured.

methods.name: nsif_cpun_save_test_arg
methods.description: Saves a test argument string into a dynamically allocated array, reallocates if needed.

methods.name: nsif_cpun_pre_hw_init_hooks
methods.description: Pre hardware init hook, runs native tasks, connects PHY, and passes test args.

methods.name: nsif_cpun_boot
methods.description: Performs boot sequence, including native tasks, BST init, and POSIX boot.

methods.name: nsif_cpun_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up POSIX SOC and returns BST result.

methods.name: nsif_cpun_test_hook
methods.description: Test hook that ticks the BST timer.
